correctness.rationale: For each test vector the conditioning quadratic form is the minimum over the observation coefficient of a nonnegative prior quadratic form plus a noise quadratic form. This proves Loewner monotonicity even for singular P_r and the bound 0≤K(P)−K(P_r)≤P. For the scalar row t e₁ᵀ+t² e_{r+1}ᵀ with R=1, the retained-coordinate posterior entries for the truncated and full priors tend to 0 and λ₁ respectively. The first diagonal difference thus proves sharpness by itself, even with eigenvalue multiplicities. The formula K(M)=M^{1/2}(I+M^{1/2}HᵀR^{-1}HM^{1/2})^{-1}M^{1/2} shows that alignment decouples the blocks even for singular M; the retained blocks cancel and the omitted block is bounded by P−P_r. The exact 2D rank-one update in RESULT.md lines 70–83 gives the stated amplification condition, including no amplification when b=0 or κ=1. At x=y=κ=100 it gives the stated rational witness. These checks concern a supremum over unbounded sensor coefficients, not finite attainment, and exact covariance conditioning only. The supplied verifier was inspected, not executed; no finite tests are needed for the universal conclusion.
